result.brief: 提出 Libra 解耦视觉-语言架构，通过 switch attention/FFN 分离自模态建模与跨模态交互，统一图像理解与文生图，并改进 tokenization 与位置编码。
result.reason: Libra decouples self-modal modeling from cross-modal interaction via switch attention/FFN, a shared architecture for unified image understanding and text-to-image generation, with tokenization improvements.
